summary: Retested the iteration 6 fixes for the Code Generator. Safety: a Playwright route guard aborted POST */replays and heartbeats, no session mutations were made, and localStorage 'amts.codegen.config.v1' was cleared at the end (confirmed null). BACKEND: test_codegen_external.py now has 5 new tests and passes 20/20 against the public URL. The isolated suites test_codegen.py and test_units.py pass 27/27. Verified: renaming 'public class Deneme3Steps' to 'OtherName' gives javac FAIL with a 'dosya yoluyla eşleşmiyor' detail and an overall FAILED. Changing the package to com.other also gives FAIL/FAILED. Unchanged files are still VERIFIED. javaVersion 21 gives javac PARTIAL and NOT_VERIFIED on generate, on validate, and in the ZIP header X-AMTS-Validation. FRONTEND: all requested flows pass. The 422 toast has no 'Value error, ' prefix. An invalid saved config (inherited driver mode, empty baseClass) shows an inline cg-plan-error after reload. Both cg-plan-error-reset and cg-config-reset restore the defaults, clear storage and load the plan. After generating, changing a config field (text, switch or select) sets data-status=STALE. Edit, then cg-file-reset, restores VERIFIED without clicking Doğrula. Typing a character and deleting it also restores VERIFIED. The Java 21 banner shows NOT_VERIFIED / PARTIAL. DENEME-3 generate is VERIFIED, and the ZIP amts-deneme-3-gauge.zip downloads with a VERIFIED toast. Found 2 minor state edge cases (see issues).

ui_bugs.issue: The pristine check uses '!planStale'. 'Adımları incele' after a config change sets planStale=false while the files are still from the old config. A later edit plus cg-file-reset then restores genValidation, which came from the old config. Reproduced: generate with Java 21 (NOT_VERIFIED), switch to Java 11, click Adımları incele, edit, reset. The banner shows NOT_VERIFIED from the Java 21 run. The reverse case can show VERIFIED for a config the files were not validated against. Fix: store the config used at generate time (e.g. JSON.stringify(cleanCfg(cfg))) and restore genValidation only if the current config equals it and the files equal the originals.

resetCfg does not mark the validation stale when files exist (updateCfg does). After a header 'Varsayılanlara dön' with generated files, the banner keeps the old config's result even though Validate and ZIP now use the defaults. The auto-review also switches to the review tab (setTab('review')). There is no try/catch around http.get('/codegen/defaults').

design_issues.screen: CodeGenerator after reload with invalid config
issues: The same 422 error toast appears twice. The auto-plan effect likely runs twice: React StrictMode double-runs the defaults fetch, so setCfg is called twice and review() has no guard against running twice. It is probably dev-only, but a guard (skip if busy==='plan') would avoid it.

action_items: Optional (LOW): in edit(), restore genValidation only when the current config equals the config used at generate time, not just when !planStale
Optional (LOW): resetCfg should setStale(true) when files exist, as updateCfg does, and handle errors
critical_code_review_comments: validate.check_javac: the path/package/class check is correct. Note that _CLS only matches a 'public' top-level type at line start, so a file whose only class is package-private gets FAIL ('?'). This is acceptable but worth a clearer message
CodeGenerator.edit calls setValidation inside the setFiles updater function. That is a side effect in an updater; it works, but computing pristine outside the updater is cleaner
api.errMsg strips 'Value error, ' only for detail[0]; multiple 422 errors show only the first one

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (2 low-priority edge cases)
